name: NGC 5831 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 5831, a spheroidal galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc5831-hubble
story: Hubble looked at this spheroidal galaxy as part of a census of faintly glowing black holes in galaxy cores, checking whether a dense cluster of stars crowds its center.

claims.text: NGC 5831 is one of the faint nearby spheroidal galaxies with faint X-ray cores targeted by program 12591
The program is a census of accreting black holes and nuclear star clusters; the images reveal whether nuclear star clusters are present
